about: Your own notes on which way a line of apartments faces -- after a viewing, or from a floorplan. The key is 'BUILDING ADDRESS|LINE LETTER' as the listings write them. facing: compass directions of its windows (N, NNE, NE, ... NNW); street: true if it looks onto a street. These win over anything worked out. Keys starting with EXAMPLE are ignored.
